definitions.scope: Distinct linked shadow commercial entities; test/control excluded. Structured membership overlaps commercial origins. Assigned market on held records is discovery identity, not verified geography.
definitions.domain_scope: Detailed domain rows cover every structured-member source family and include all origins on those domains. Legacy-only domains are counted separately; their entities/reasons remain in all_commercial totals.
definitions.dispositions: READY/WATCH/quarantined/blocked are exclusive. Verification/stale flags and blocker categories overlap; do not sum them.
definitions.source_reasons: Retained latest proof reason codes plus current eligibility and freshness. Expired parser reasons are diagnostic history, not a claim of a new visit.
definitions.source_verified_but_not_ready: Current revision/version/TTL-matched parser VERIFIED report, but selection comparison, identity/evidence holds, eligibility or readiness blocks the entity.
definitions.selected_mismatch_review: Source complete means current proof has only selected-field disagreement reasons. Organiser-only review candidates additionally have no other eligibility/identity/legacy hold and selected organiser/location present. These counts are review populations, not promised READY upside; no selection is changed by this tool.
definitions.open_cohort: Selected OPEN_NOW fields, not producer raw volume or independently proved current applications.
